solution_text:

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Deceptive" means giving a false or misleading impression. Its closest synonym among the options is "misleading". (भ्रामक)

◦ Example: The advertisement's deceptive (misleading) claims misled thousands of customers into buying a product with no real benefits.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1 "Complete" means including all or nearly all elements of something — different in sense from "deceptive".

• Option 3 "Pale" means resembling a corpse; very pale, thin, and gaunt — different in sense from "deceptive".

• Option 4 "Dedicate" means give a large part of one's time or effort to something — different in sense from "deceptive".

 

NOTE

• Synonym of deceptive: misleading. Antonyms: honest, truthful.
